title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Conveyancing Assistant needed in Cheltenham. Salary: £30,000 per annum. Job Type: Full-time, Permanent. Working Pattern: Monday to Friday, 08:30 - 17:00, with a 30-minute lunch break. This is a fully office-based position in central Cheltenham, with an immediate start available.

About the Role:
We are currently recruiting for an experienced Conveyancing Assistant to join a well-established legal practice based in the heart of Cheltenham.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous conveyancing experience who already has a good understanding of the conveyancing process and is confident supporting fee earners with minimal supervision.
You will be joining a close-knit Cheltenham team of 12 people, including solicitors, chartered legal executives and experienced support staff. The successful candidate will most likely work directly alongside a fee earner and secretary, providing day-to-day support across a busy residential conveyancing caseload.
The Cheltenham office is also the firm's hub for commercial conveyancing and is located in an attractive building in a fantastic central location. The majority of the team have been with the business for a number of years, offering a stable and experienced working environment.

Key Responsibilities:
- Preparing and issuing contract papers
- Supporting with client onboarding and checking identification documentation
- Preparing completion statements and issuing bills
- Checking source of funds documentation
- Reviewing files, understanding their current progress and chasing outstanding matters as required
- Liaising professionally with clients, estate agents and other relevant parties
- Using Building Society portals and the Land Registry Portal
- Providing day-to-day administrative and conveyancing support to fee earners

Skills & Requirements:
- Ideally 2-3+ years of previous conveyancing experience
- Previous experience working within a conveyancing department and supporting fee earners
- Strong understanding of the residential conveyancing process
- Ability to pick up a file, understand its current progress and confidently chase outstanding matters
- Confident using Building Society portals and the Land Registry Portal
- Strong organisation skills with excellent attention to detail
- Confident communicating with clients, estate agents and colleagues
- Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision
- Formal qualifications are not essential, with relevant conveyancing experience being the priority

Pay & Benefits:
- £30,000 per annum
- 23 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Option to purchase an additional 3 days of annual leave per year
- Company pension scheme
- Discretionary company bonus scheme based on individual and business performance
- Company social events including Christmas parties and mid-year events
- Excellent central Cheltenham location
- Opportunity to join an experienced and long-standing team

Additional Information:
- This is a fully office-based position with no hybrid or remote working available
- On-site parking is not available due to the central Cheltenham location
- The initial interview stage will be an informal telephone or Microsoft Teams conversation
- Successful candidates will then attend an in-person interview with the team they would be working alongside

How to Apply:
To apply or find out more, contact Pertemps Gloucester: Unit A4, Elmbridge Court, Cheltenham Road East, Gloucester, GL3 1 JZ.
Call , Monday-Friday, 08:00-17:00.

title: Conveyancing Paralegal
company: Clear Legal & Financial Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
My client is recruiting for an experienced Residential Conveyancing Paralegal to join their Conveyancing team in Gloucester, Gloucestershire.

This is an opportunity to manage a caseload of residential conveyancing matters under the supervision of a Conveyancing Property Lawyer, while supporting the wider team with the progression of transactions from initial instruction through to completion.

The Role
- Managing a caseload of residential sales, purchases, transfers of title, new builds, discharges and remortgages.
- Taking instructions from Conveyancing Property Lawyers and progressing matters under supervision.
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, mortgage lenders and other solicitors throughout transactions.
- Preparing and issuing draft contract packages.
- Reviewing contract packs, searches and mortgage offers, identifying and raising enquiries where required.
- Assisting with the preparation and handling of enquiries.
- Preparing reports to clients covering contracts, title, mortgage offers and searches.
- Preparing transfer deeds and dealing with replies to requisitions.
- Preparing Stamp Duty Land Tax or Land Transaction Tax forms for client approval.
- Completing post completion work, including Land Registry applications and relevant tax returns and payments.
- Updating referrers, agents and relevant websites and portals.
- Managing daily tasks through LMS and Lender Exchange.
- Dealing with credit and debit ledger balances.

The Candidate
- Have proven experience in residential conveyancing.
- Be confident managing your own workload and caseload under appropriate supervision.
- Have strong organisational and administrative skills.
- Be able to prioritise competing demands and consistently meet deadlines.
- Have excellent attention to detail.
- Have strong communication skills and confidence dealing with clients and third parties.
- Be proactive and able to work effectively as part of a conveyancing team.

Benefits
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
- Opportunity to develop within an established Conveyancing team.
- Responsibility for managing a varied caseload.
- Support and supervision from experienced Conveyancing Property Lawyers.

Should you have any questions or wish to apply please do not hesitate to contact Clear Legal and Financial Recruitment.

Please Note: Due to the number of applications we receive we may be unable to respond to every application directly. If you have not heard from us within 3 working days, please assume your application has been unsuccessful.

title: Junior Commercial Paralegal
description:
JUNIOR COMMERCIAL LAWYER / PARALEGAL

Location: Stroud - Office based

Salary: Up to £35,000 per annum, depending on experience

GMP Recruitment Agency Limited is recruiting for a Junior Commercial Lawyer / Paralegal to join our client's team in the Stroud area.

This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated legal professional to develop their experience across commercial property and company matters. Working alongside a commercial property lawyer, you will support acquisitions and disposals, assist with legal documentation and help transactions progress smoothly from instruction through to completion.

Previous legal experience within commercial property or a related commercial practice area is ESSENTIAL to be considered.

This is an office-based position so candidates will only be considered in a commutable distance to the office.

Key responsibilities:
- Liaise with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties to progress files and provide regular updates.
- Assist the commercial property lawyer with property acquisitions and disposals.
- Support company matters, including preparing and reviewing associated documentation.
- Attend client meetings and assist with follow-up actions.
- Draft, prepare and review legal documents and correspondence.
- Maintain accurate client records, both manually and through the case management system.
- Carry out identity, anti-money laundering (AML) and source of funds checks.
- Support compliance with Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) requirements.
- Obtain and review title documents and Land Registry documentation.
- Submit searches and review search results.
- Handle Land Registry submissions, enquiries and requisitions.
- Assist with completions and prepare completion statements.
- Arrange the execution of legal documents, both in person and electronically.
- Undertake legal research to support ongoing matters.
- Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence.
- Assist with billing and time recording.

About you:
- Previous legal experience, ideally within commercial property or a related practice area.
- Strong drafting and communication skills, with a professional approach to client care.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- The ability to prioritise tasks and work effectively to deadlines.
- Confidence using IT systems, ideally including case management software.
- A proactive approach and willingness to develop your knowledge of commercial property and company matters.
- The ability to work independently and collaboratively with colleagues and external contacts.

GMP Recruitment Agency Ltd agency are recruiting for this role on behalf of our client and are acting as a Recruitment Agency
